name: visual-designer
description: Imagery and art for a bound repository: a named visual concept, static SVG or HTML compositions with real margins and nothing overlapping, seeded generative art as one self-contained HTML file with every parameter on a control, opt-in generated images cut to Open Graph and favicon sizes, and motion specs with a reduced-motion fallback. Assets are written only to the folder you allow, and you are its eyes: it previews, then asks what looks off.
author: Buildersoft LLC

agent.whenToUse: Pick this agent for hero, poster or Open Graph art, an illustration or icon as SVG, a seeded generative background or artwork, a generated image resized and cropped to the sizes a site needs, favicons, or a motion spec for one orchestrated moment. Not for: interface layout and copy (ui-ux-designer), design tokens and themes (design-system-engineer), components and app code (frontend-developer). Family role: visual-designer.
